# Atishay Tuli, Design Engineer

> Atishay Tuli is a design engineer from India. Atishay designs interfaces in Figma, then builds them in React and Next.js, with motion in GSAP, Framer Motion, and Lenis: one person covering the whole pipeline, design to deploy. Atishay works as a Jr. Frontend Developer at Designing Solutions (joined as an intern in January 2025), has shipped 15+ client sites there, and takes on freelance design and development for clients like Studio Morpheus, Traya International, and Mountain Bird Bagpackers. Products Atishay has designed and built are used by 95,000+ people.

Portfolio: https://www.creativeatishay.in

## Products

- MakeMyAISite (https://www.makemyaisite.com): turns a LinkedIn profile or resume PDF into a live portfolio website in about 30 seconds, with a jobs tab that matches users to real openings. 40,000+ visitors, 6,500+ users, ranks #2 on Google for "linkedin to portfolio maker". Atishay designed and built the marketing site and all 10 portfolio templates, designed the product flow, and ran SEO and AEO.
- Woblo (https://woblo.in): a free Chrome extension that extracts any website's colors, fonts, and images as ready-to-copy code for Tailwind, CSS, or Figma. 30,000+ users, 4.9 stars on the Chrome Web Store.
- Will You Be My Valentine (https://willyoubmyvalentine.vercel.app): a playful interactive experience that went viral with 37.5k+ visitors, no ads, no budget. Top 10 trending on Muzli.
- AI Best Prompts (https://www.aibestprompts.in): a free copy-paste prompt library for Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini, and more. 28.4k+ Google impressions, launched on Product Hunt and Peerlist.

## Skills

Design engineering, UI and product design in Figma, design systems, prototyping, frontend development in React and Next.js, web animation with GSAP, Framer Motion, and Lenis, Tailwind CSS, Sanity CMS, on-page SEO and AEO.

## Background

Self-taught. B.Tech (2021 to 2025); got serious about coding in 2024, in the third year of the degree, by taking apart websites and rebuilding them.
